notes.title: Minor updates for the demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41402470/76f05a93e328d2ded44f5f9dd38713c19c5feb0a.png[/img]

[i]Citizens of Amsterdam[/i],

12 million souls will be governed by our new AI mayor, as willed by the majority that voted "Yes" in the referundum. We would like to thank those of you who put your trust in the GMAI Corporation.

We would also like to thank everyone that has supported us in the weeks following the referendum: our wishlisters who give more visibility to the project, our demo players who have given us valuable feedback and any onlookers who have stumbled upon our game. 

Work on the game is continuing and, thanks to you, Citizens of Amsterdam, we've managed to refine our vision of the final product. [b]We've received a lot of good feedback that has made the round of the office and had us considering some decisions. [/b]

As a result, we are releasing some of these tweaks to the demo as well, for you to test and give feedback on. These include: 

[b]•    A bit more voice over added for some characters.
•    The AI Mayor will be a bit better at reflecting your teachings in its appearance.
•    Clearer tutorializing for the Quantum Security puzzle stages of the demo, which should make the objectives a bit clearer.
[/b]
[url= https://discord.gg/BWFpm47pnj]Join us on Discord[/url] to discuss updates to the GMAI project and remember, the future of Amsterdam is in your hands!

notes.title: Good Morning AI - LIVE Developer Commentary on DEMO
notes.content:
[h2]You've stumbled into a crazy future - not because it's outlandish, but because it's uncanny.[/h2]

[previewyoutube=lvvNGOLjZyE;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Good Morning A.I[/i] is a [b]Visual-Novel[/b] that combines [b]rich roleplaying[/b] with [b]puzzle/tower defense[/b] gameplay.

[h2]New problems, old solutions?[/h2]

[b]The setting is straightforward: [i]the year is 2064 and Amsterdam voted to have an A.I run its administration[/i].[/b]

There's age-old problems, human fears and geopolitical conundrums, and also woes of a futuristic Europe. Coastlines are under water, refugees scatter around the globe, UBI might not have turned out great for everyone.

Some hope the G.M.A.I project is a solution, some fear it's part of the problem, and many know you have a hand in how it will all pan out. Friends and strangers will make their voices heard.

[h2]30 endings for you to discover[/h2]

The game has around 30 endings, states of the world concluding the job you do by teaching the A.I about life. 

In many ways, the A.I acts a mirror to our own beliefs, testing our own worldview as we play.  [b][i]You're invited to see how your own theoretical approaches and the realities of this fictional world clash and to discover as many endings as possible.[/i][/b]
